svg.title: One attention head, by hand
svg.desc: One attention head worked with real numbers. Four panels left to right: Q, K and V as 4 by 4 matrices of small integers; the score matrix S = QK^T, then the same matrix divided by the square root of the head width, which is 2; the weights A, the softmax of each row, printed to two decimals beside an accent-marked column of row sums that all read 1.00; and the output Y = A V. One score is expanded term by term beneath the score grids: S11 = 1 times 0 plus minus 1 times minus 1 plus 1 times 0 plus minus 1 times 0, which is 1. Each of the four query positions peaks at a different key position. A key gives the model constants, three equations, a twelve-entry symbol glossary, and F.scaled_dot_product_attention with comments mapping the call onto the same symbols.
svg.text: T = 4 positions · d_h = 4 head width (= d/h) · one head · B = 1
